For a cubic crystal, the full 6×6 elastic tensor in Voigt notation is:

```
| C11 C12 C12  0   0   0  |
| C12 C11 C12  0   0   0  |
| C12 C12 C11  0   0   0  |
|  0   0   0  C44  0   0  |
|  0   0   0   0  C44  0  |
|  0   0   0   0   0  C44 |
```

```
| 47  12  12   0   0   0 |

|  0   0   0  12   0   0 |
|  0   0   0   0  12   0 |
|  0   0   0   0   0  12 |
```

This is the full elastic tensor for NaCl in units of GPa.
